item.title: What is a Digital Twin?
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
What is a digital twin?
#

A digital twin is a virtual representation of a real-world entity or process, created to simulate its behavior and performance. It consists of three main components: representation of the physical entity itself, the digital model that represents it, and the data that links the two (original and twin). Keep in mind the data is generated by model based on the representation of the physical entity. This technology allows users to monitor, analyze, and optimize the performance of physical objects or systems in real-time by providing insights based on data collected from sensors and IoT devices [1][2][3].

item.title: Types of Technologies
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
How Many Types of Technologies?
#

There is no single official count. Schools often teach 7 types of technology. Business talks use other groups: disruptive, emerging, green, fintech. This page starts with the seven, then lists more groups you will hear at work.

New to the Data Science section? See Start Here.

7 types of technology
#

# Type What it does Examples
1 Information technology Store, process, and send data Computers, software, the internet
2 Communication technology Move a message from one person or machine to another Phones, radio, messaging apps
3 Medical technology Diagnose, treat, or prevent illness Imaging, implants, gene therapy
4 Energy and green technology Make, store, or use energy with less harm Solar, wind, batteries, electric vehicles
5 Manufacturing and automation Make goods or do physical work with machines Industrial robots, 3D printing, factory lines
6 Education technology Teach and learn Online courses, classroom apps, VR labs
7 Entertainment technology Play, watch, or listen Games, streaming, virtual reality

These seven overlap. A phone is communication and IT. An MRI scanner is medical and IT. That is normal.

item.title: AI Use Cases in Food Processing
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
AI Use Cases in Food Processing
#

Introduction
#

The food processing industry is a vital sector in the global economy, responsible for providing safe and nutritious food to millions of people around the world. Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly used in the food processing industry to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the quality and safety of food products. From automated sorting and grading of fruits and vegetables to intelligent vending machines, AI is being used in a wide range of applications across the food processing industry.
